notes: Registered 2026-08-29, the day the repo itself came into being: thumbnail-generator was split out of life-hub as the DJ Cylow thumbnail pipeline's own repo, and adopted the specialists in its own PR #1 the same morning. That PR carried the [UNREGISTERED] finding out as an issue on the consumer (thumbnail-generator#3) rather than silently, so the gap this manifest closes lasted hours instead of the days djcylow-react's did. THE REGISTRATION DELIBERATELY WAITED FOR THAT PR TO MERGE. Its whole install -- .claude/settings.json and all 19 lenses -- lived only on the branch, and check 3 reads the consumer's working tree: a manifest written while main was still empty would have reported 19 registered extensions as missing and turned this entry red on arrival. That is the doctrine in this folder's README from the other side -- the register books what a consumer HAS -- and this is the first entry where the wait was the whole decision rather than a note afterwards. MEASURED AFTER THE MERGE, not taken from the PR: their live .claude/settings.json enables team-alpha@ and contributing-davekjohn@, both under the post-August-26 names, so this record starts with nothing to catch up on. 19 lens files under .claude/specialists/lenses/, against the 15 agents + 4 personas team-alpha ships -- an exact match, the same full adoption as djcylow-react. The four personas (01-01, 03-02, 05-05, 05-06) carry the '> Repo-lens (lens-only persona)' blockquote and no body copy, the life-hub model, so they report LENS-ONLY rather than DRIFTED. contributing-davekjohn ships no agents/, hence the deliberately empty extension list -- the same measured answer as the other four manifests. ONE THING IS KNOWINGLY LEFT OPEN: this machine holds no install record for this checkout, so check 4 reports [NOT-INSTALLED-HERE] until a session actually starts in that repo and Claude Code writes the record itself. That is the machine's state and not this register's, and nothing here can or should write it. VISIBILITY: the repo is private and this repo is public, which is why registering it needed Dave's word rather than a session's judgement -- given 2026-08-29. Same boundary and same answer as life-hub.json: metadata only, no lens content, no absolute paths. MIGRATED 2026-09-11 (#1769), on flag day itself and after this consumer, exactly as decision A (Dave, 2026-09-10) prescribed: the register writes a renamed id only after the consumer itself has migrated. Measured in the consumer rather than taken from a plan: its .claude/settings.json on main names, after the merge, only <plugin>@dkj-claude-plugins and no @claude-code-specialists at all. The marketplace has been called dkj-claude-plugins since v5.0.0; there is NO redirect on a marketplace name the way there is on a repo slug, so the reinstall per machine and per checkout is what finishes this migration, and this register cannot see it. NOT MEASURED in this pass: the extension inventories, the machine versions and the drift figures -- all carried over unchanged. The sentences above keep the names they were written with, per #952. OWNER MOVED 2026-09-24 (#2420): the repo was transferred from DaveKJohn into the DKJ-Solutions org (thumbnail-generator PR #26), and the register had not followed, so the consumer's session check reported [ERROR] against its own origin. Measured, not taken from the report: gh resolves DKJ-Solutions/thumbnail-generator as the canonical name. Only the repo field changed; the inventories and versions above are untouched.
